title: My Desert-Strike inspired first game attempt
author: stunware
selftext:
Hi,

I've been a developer for about 15 years, but I've never made a game before.

When I was a kid I played Desert Strike on the SNES. I wanted to make something like it, so I started building one in Three.js with a lot of help from AI. I'd like to know what you think. What looks good, what looks bad, what you would change.



I made a short gameplay video.



Some things about it:



1. It runs in a browser. You can play with an Xbox or DualShock controller, or with keyboard and mouse.



2. The 3D models are free ones I found online, mostly from polyhaven.com and sketchfab.com.



3. There are no sound files in the project. Not one .wav. Every sound is made with DSP while the game runs. The gun sounds come from the real ballistics: how much powder the round has, what calibre it is, and what it hits.



4. The flight model uses real numbers, not numbers I picked because they felt right. Engine power, inertia, the gearbox, the main rotor and the tail rotor are all in there, all running in real time.



5. There's a micro-aim mode. You focus, and you can aim the gun much more precisely.



6. I tried to copy how the real M230 chain gun and the M134, M28 and GAU-19 gatlings work. Fire rate, spin up, heat, and the sound of each one. Ricochets too, and the crack you hear when a round goes past you.



7. There's turbulence and drag. The air moves, and the helicopter gets pushed around by it. I didn't really show this in the video.



8. Also not in the video: there are two sound modes. One is what the pilot hears in the cockpit, one is what you hear from an outside camera. I tried to copy what a real flight helmet does to loud sounds.



9. There's a design mode in the game where you can shape the terrain. It's still very basic.



10. Dust, particles, smoke, echo and reverb, plus some work on map performance. All basic.



I didn't want to use Unity. Partly the licence, partly because I didn't want the game to depend on an engine.



Any advice would help. Thanks.
